title: Genome-wide knockout screen of OC43/SARS-CoV2-infected HEK293-hACE2 cells I
model: HEK293T-hACE2 cells, Brunello genome-wide knockout library, SARS-CoV-2 / OC43 survival selection
contrast: Initial infection vs Day 0: SARS-CoV-2 (4 vs 4), OC43 (5 vs 4)
paper_method: MAGeCK RRA, positively selected genes (Additional files 6 and 8)
paper_calls: EDC4 top SARS-CoV-2 gene with XRN1, CCZ1, DNM2, WASL; TMEM41B, VMP1, CCZ1B, SLC35B2, WDR81 for OC43
barcs_calls: SARS-CoV-2: 33 enriched at FDR 0.10 after control calibration; OC43: 7 enriched (median-ratio totals)
named_hits: SARS-CoV-2 7/7 at FDR 0.10 (EDC4 #1); OC43 3/5 (VMP1 #1, SLC35B2 #4, CCZ1B #5; TMEM41B #10 at FDR 0.11)
verdict: BARCS puts EDC4 first and calls all named SARS-CoV-2 host factors; for OC43 it shares 18 of the top 20 genes and calls VMP1, SLC35B2 and CCZ1B, with TMEM41B just above FDR 0.10.
